key_points: Chevron CEO warns of tighter oil markets, suggesting potential price support.
OPEC+ pause keeps crude elevated, bolstering upstream earnings.
Institutional buyers (Ferguson Wellman, CapWealth) increased stakes, while MassMutual trimmed a small position.
Leadership change: Eimear Bonner appointed President of Oil, Products & Gas (effective 2027) and incoming CFO.
Buyback guidance highlighted as a catalyst; stock up ~36% YTD and nearing all‑time highs.
